messages.content:
Diagnosis:
The test `testOptionGroupLong()` fails because an OptionGroup doesn't properly handle selecting options that only have a long name without a short name. Looking into the `OptionGroup.setSelected(Option)` method, the selection depends on comparing and setting the `selected` field with the result of `option.getOpt()`, which returns the short name or "opt" string of the option.

In the test, the options are created using `OptionBuilder.withLongOpt("foo").create()` which sets only a long option without a short name. The `opt` (short name) is never set in this case and thus `option.getOpt()` returns null or an empty string. The `setSelected` method compares `selected` with `option.getOpt()`, and if `option.getOpt()` is empty, it doesn't correctly set the selected option, effectively having no effect.

This explains the test failure where after parsing the command line `--bar`, the option group should have `bar` as the selected option, but `group.getSelected()` returns null or empty because the `selected` field is never properly set.

Hence, the root cause is that the `OptionGroup.setSelected(Option)` method assumes the presence of a short option string (`opt`) to identify the selected option, but this is not valid when the option only has a long option name and no short option. The method needs to handle selection by long option name if no short name exists, or the `selected` field and related logic need to be adjusted for such cases.

No other recent bug reports are directly related, so the diagnosis is based on the current report, failing test, and source code review.
org.apache.commons.cli.OptionGroup.setSelected(org.apache.commons.cli.Option)

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
